description: A Solana transaction by signature: status, time, fee in SOL and USD, signers, SOL balance changes per account, token balance changes (mint, owner, change) and the programs it invoked. Read-only; nothing is sent. A very new signature may be missing (404, not charged). Related tools on this server, for a different need: solana_account when you need a Solana account: lamports and SOL with a USD value, owner; solana_quote when you need Best Jupiter swap route for a Solana token pair. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: solana_tx
title: Check a Solana transaction's status, fee and balance changes
